messages:
Devon: Hey, FYI CI is red on main — intermittent failure in runtime::serving::tests::kv_prefetch_order. First seen in 1847654321
ci-bot: build 12458 failed: https://ci.redwood.com/build/12458/tests/failed (test: kv_prefetch_order) :rotating_light:
Tao: can someone /retest? Looks timing-sensitive, possibly scheduler jitter
Maria: /retest
ci-bot: rebuild queued by Maria — job 12459
Devon: adding a stack trace I grabbed from the failure logs:
```
thread 'test_kv_prefetch_order' panicked at 'assertion failed: left == right', src/serving/cache/prefill.rs:142
stack backtrace:
 0: std::panicking::begin_panic
 1: serving::cache::prefill::tests::kv_prefetch_order
```
Ana: I've seen this locally when running with --test-threads=1 it passes, with default threads it flakes. Could be ordering in background prefetch tasks.
Sasha: @Kevin can you run a bisect? Might be a regression after 0.9.3
Kevin: running bisection against master@{yesterday}..master, will post results in ~20m
Tao: short-term: marking test as flaky in CI and adding a deterministic join in prefetch to avoid nondeterminism? Not ideal but unblocks
Devon: agreed. Can we instead add a small barrier in test to wait for background queue to drain? e.g.,
```
prefetch_queue.wait_for_empty(Duration::from_millis(200));
```
Maria: I'll open the PR to skip unstable behavior in CI and add the test-join change as a followup. PR in draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/876
ci-bot: job 12459 succeeded
Kevin: bisect results: flake introduced in commit 037a9b2 — related to prefetch task yield change. Suggest reverting small change and rework yield.
Devon: great find. let's patch and rerun full suite tomorrow. :thumbsup:
